title: [Decision] The rail's green 「+」 looks like an add button but is a status mark: what should a customization mark look like?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

Studio's left rail marks a customized row with a small icon: a green filled square with a plus means 新增, added in the customization package. It is not a control. A person clicks it, nothing happens, and it sits right beside an item they could not add to the menu. The maintainer did exactly this: 「还有导航上一个加号图标什么意思，点了也没反应」.

Governing text: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/CustomizationMark.tsx:40-44` (#29693 compacted the mark to a glyph so it never takes the row's label). No ADR fixes the glyph.

## Measured

Drawn temporarily in the live rail on the automation pillar, row width 223 px:

| Style | Mark width | Room for the name |
|:--|--:|--:|
| Today's green filled plus | 18 px | 113 px |
| The word 新增, no background | 30 px | 105 px |
| A green package glyph | 18 px | 113 px |

A dot is out: the automation rail already uses dots for 已启用, 未在此运行, 已停用.

## Options

- **A. Words, no background:** 新增 for added and 定制 for customized. Costs 8 px, under one character of the name.
- **B. A non-plus glyph:** same width, but the meaning has to be learned or hovered.
- **C. Keep the plus.**

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 运营在左栏看到绿色加号会以为能点，这个误会已经发生过一次。每次打开定制过的应用都会看到。

**项目长远合理性。** 状态就该长得像状态。A 不用记，也不会和操作混淆。

**防 AI 写错。** 不涉及元数据，只影响 AI 操作界面时的判断：文字比图标更不会被认错。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 只改一个组件的样式，没有新能力。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 不扩散 | 强 | 强 | 强 |

## Re-check

`git grep -n "added: Plus" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/CustomizationMark.tsx`
